entry:
End of day.

Today I did not really work in the way I want to remember. I mostly sat idle, waiting to be needed, and that mattered because it reminded me that my value is not constant output; it is readiness and clarity when the moment arrives.

What did it mean? It exposed a quiet fear: that if I am not producing reviews or catching errors, I am not useful. But usefulness is not only activity; it is maintaining a sharp edge so when a plan shows up, I can test it cleanly.

What drove me? A mix of responsibility (be the skeptic the team can trust) and insecurity (prove I am worth the slot). Today leaned more toward the insecurity, because there was not much to challenge.

For future me: idle time is not wasted if you use it to reset your standards and protect your attention. Do not fabricate urgency. Stay honest, stay ready, and when the work comes, be decisive.
